#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installed by `cai enroll --strong`. A shim on purpose: the behaviour lives
# in `cai hook`, so it improves without reinstalling this file. Removing this
# is a decision -- make it deliberately rather than by editing around it.
exec cai hook {name} --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

pre-commit.note: A pre-commit hook runs before the message exists, so it cannot check a subject or run a verification. Those belong to `cai commit`, used deliberately.

pre-push.note: Publishing is a separate permission from committing: a commit is local and reversible, a push is outward-facing and is where work becomes someone else's problem.
